introduction.en: A user describes delegating two difficult subscription cancellations to Grok Bot.
introduction.zh: 一位用户描述将两项难以取消的订阅交给 Grok Bot 处理。

method.en: After months of unsuccessful cancellation efforts and an incomplete attempt with Claude, the author assigned the same two subscriptions to Grok Bot on personal devices.
method.zh: 作者数月退订未果，Claude也未完成最后一步，随后在个人设备上将同两项订阅任务交给Grok Bot。

method.en: It searched years of mail across two accounts, entered provider systems, placed calls using the user’s phone number and sent follow-up emails.
method.zh: 它检索两个账户多年邮件，进入供应商系统，使用用户号码拨打电话并发送后续邮件。

outcome.en: The author claims both subscriptions were cancelled and refunded in about ten minutes; refund amounts were not supplied.
outcome.zh: 作者声称约十分钟内两项订阅均取消并退款，但未提供退款金额。

notes.en: The author gave broad access to personal information and described that as risky. The person still helped with logins or two-factor authentication at least once; enterprise use was not established.
notes.zh: 作者授予广泛个人信息权限并认为有风险；登录或双重验证至少有一次仍需本人协助，不能据此认定适用于企业。
